content.title:
TheArtRevival on Instagram: "Are you surprised?

Banksy’s identity revealed! @banksy"
content.text: Are you surprised?Banksy’s identity revealed! @banksyI don't care what they found. I don't want to know. I don't want to see the name. It's how he intended his identity to BE and that's how respect goeaImage if they put this much detective work into EpsteinThis is like unmasking batman 👎If that tech is supposed to find dangerous criminals they could've used it to find a dangerous criminal as an example not "unmask" an artist. I just think they wanted to use Bansky as a warning to other artists who think of speaking out against them 🙌🏻If you live in Bristol for a while and pay attention then it becomes apparent that lots of people know who Banksy is. Any particularly determined person could figure it out with some time and talking to some of the right people. But most people dont because what would be the point? The magic is that there isn't some flawed regular (and also brilliant) human being to undermine the art itself. Trying to figure it out is a real sad sack move...They could’ve used that time and energy unmasking an actual criminalSuprised? No. Mind-blown that Reuters thought this was in the public's interest? Yes, unfortunately.Didn’t MIT students find his identity using serial killer tracking years ago (6+?) and there was a photo from near a artwork at a school, his facial structure was the same. And the same as the facial structure of Mr brainwash in exit through the gift shop. Starring in his own movie with none of us knowing?I hate how people just assume the "public" collectively want the same thing all the time without ever actually consulting with the public.They just ruined the magic. What are they going after next Santa Claus in the Easter bunny?Can they do any British who is in Epstein files then?I respect his wishes and his desire to stay anonymous.At the end of the day, we're all just people being people, some are named Banksy, others have other names ♡
